datasets.name: forecast_churn
queryLines:
SELECT
  *
FROM
  ai_forecast(
    TABLE (

      SELECT
        DATE(mes) AS ds,
        SUM(facturacion_total_usd) AS facturacion
      FROM
        classic_stable_douglas_s_catalog.quetzal_telecom.gold_billing_health
      GROUP BY
        DATE(mes)
      ORDER BY
        ds
    ),
    horizon => DATE '2026-12-31',
    time_col => 'ds',
    value_col => 'facturacion',
    prediction_interval_width => 0.95,
    version => '2'

datasets.name: forecast_revenue
queryLines:
SELECT
  *
FROM
  ai_forecast(
    TABLE (

      SELECT
        DATE(mes) as ds,
        SUM(ingresos_totales_usd) as ingresos
      FROM
        classic_stable_douglas_s_catalog.quetzal_telecom.gold_revenue_by_country_service
      GROUP BY
        DATE(mes)
      ORDER BY
        ds
    ),
    horizon => DATE '2026-12-31',
    time_col => 'ds',
    value_col => 'ingresos',
    prediction_interval_width => 0.95,
    version => '2'

datasets.name: scatter_pais
datasets.displayName: Scatter — Revenue vs NPS por País
queryLines:
SELECT
  r.pais_codigo AS pais,
  SUM(r.ingresos_totales_usd) AS ingresos_totales,
  AVG(s.nps_index) AS nps_index,
  AVG(s.avg_csat) AS avg_csat,
  SUM(r.num_facturas) AS num_facturas
FROM
  classic_stable_douglas_s_catalog.quetzal_telecom.gold_revenue_by_country_service r
    JOIN classic_stable_douglas_s_catalog.quetzal_telecom.gold_customer_satisfaction s
      ON r.pais_codigo = s.pais_codigo
GROUP BY
  r.pais_codigo
ORDER BY
  ingresos_totales DESC

datasets.name: morosidad
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE(mes) AS mes,
  AVG(pct_vencida) AS pct_morosidad
FROM
  classic_stable_douglas_s_catalog.quetzal_telecom.gold_billing_health
GROUP BY
  DATE(mes)
ORDER BY
  mes
